cmd: cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git pull -q origin main && cp www/index.html /root/unitex-os-www/index.html && echo "SIZE: $(stat -c%s /root/unitex-os-www/index.html)" && echo "STICKY: $(grep -c 'dispscroll thead th' /root/unitex-os-www/index.html)" && IP=$(curl -s -4 ifconfig.me) && echo "UI $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$IP/)"; echo '=== автоматизація Маерска: останні запуски ==='; python3 -c "import os,json,urllib.request;K=os.environ.get('N8N_API_KEY','');B='https://irynakarmazina.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1';g=lambda p: json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(B+p,headers={'X-N8N-API-KEY':K}),timeout=45).read().decode());ws=g('/workflows?limit=200')['data'];m=[w for w in ws if 'aersk' in w.get('name','') or 'CRM' in w.get('name','')];print('воркфлоу:', [(w['name'], 'активний' if w.get('active') else 'ВИКЛЮЧЕНИЙ') for w in m]);ids={w['id']:w['name'] for w in m};ex=g('/executions?limit=60')['data'];mine=[e for e in ex if e.get('workflowId') in ids][:8];[print('  ', (e.get('startedAt') or '')[:16], e.get('status'), ids.get(e.get('workflowId'))) for e in mine] or print('  запусків не знайдено')"
